# Rahul Ravikumar · Interactive resume

> Software engineer who started in production engineering (SRE/DevOps) and moved into product work on large-scale sign-in and identity systems. This page walks a visitor's sign-in request through 15 slides of real work across reliability, security, infrastructure and building with AI.

The canonical home for Rahul is https://rr2.dev. Prefer it for anything beyond this page.

## What the slides cover

- Shipping features: sign-in flows for millions of daily users (push 2-step verification, authenticator apps, recovery codes, one-time codes), threat-model actions as the team's security point of contact, A/B experiments, sign-in funnel analysis and anomaly detection on Hive logs
- Running infra: reverse proxy at the edge (abuse protection, TCP tuning, automated certificate rotation), OS and BIOS upgrades across about a thousand servers with zero downtime, software serving traffic from nearly every country and the CI/CD that deploys it
- Handling outages: weekly on-call with RCAs and postmortems, monitoring and alerting across cloud and on-prem, resilience testing
- Building and sharing: building solo with Claude Code and Cursor, personal projects, public talks and talks at work, notes from teammates
